summary: Final near-expiry handoff (action=research) recording a concrete, constructible next step for the one open question on the confirmed append-log-identity claim: whether the divergent cached identity can also withhold a vote. The feedback spells out the scenario in one step - reuse the first confirmed premise (conflicting suffix truncated, then StoreLogs fails) so the node's real log ends at index 1 term 1 while its cached last entry still reads index 3 term 2; then send a RequestVote at the next term whose candidate log ends at index 2 term 2, which is strictly more up to date than the real log and must be granted, while the vote handler's up-to-date comparison reads r.getLastEntry() from the stale cache and is expected to reject it. The discriminator is the handler's own Granted field (expected true, observed false), and the remaining open question moves from local vote withholding to whether that can change an election outcome in a legal configuration. It needs no new map objects - the principal Fact, Behavior edges, binding and sources are those the accepted unit already uses - and is left unexecuted because the run is at its budget boundary, stated as a construction plan rather than a result. The other residuals are restated (Restore reporting surface, Apply/ApplyLog shutdown lead, FSM manager snapshot side, tcp transport stream/pooling, TimeoutNow-without-term and ordering-intent questions). Run outcome unchanged: six confirmed_in_scope conclusions across eight implementation_reproduced findings, map version 14. Preflight returned valid:true with roughly 600 seconds of budget left.
